title: Senior Java Backend Developer (Team, Delivery - Mortgages)
full_description:
Senior Java Backend Developer
A Senior Java Backend Developer is accountable for development and maintenance of backend applications. In this role, following functional and technical analysis, you ensure the implementations that comply with the standards relating to performance, security and code maintainability, with respect of time and budget during all phases. In this position you will be at the heart of our scalable technology platforms, being accountable for delivering common banking functionalities used in most of the propositions that ING offers to its customers.
Join us for this exciting opportunity!
Application development according to ING Bank standards
Develop source code and perform Unit Test
Collaborate with DevOps Engineers in order to manage software development lifecycle
Is responsible to implement code that is resilient against vulnerabilities and to integrate security throughout the entire software development lifecycle
Follow bugfixing during test phase (SIT and UAT)
Follow Production issue resolution in production environment
Delivery defect analysis in order to measure and recognize the goodness of solution design
Check and give feedback on functional and technical analysis, perform code review
Manage communication and escalation processes when required
Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
5+ years’ experience in the same role in a 24/7 environment preferably within banking sector
Proven skills in theAgile way of working
Proven experience in application development withJAVA on/with J2EE platform, Spring, Spring Boot
Advanced experience inREST & SOAP applicationservices development
Proven experience inMicroservicesarchitectures, implementation of robustAPImanagement
Knowledge of event-driven architecture (MQ, Kafka)
Deep understanding of distributed systems and containerization (Kubernetes, Docker)
Practical skills in automating the software development lifecycle viaCI/CD(Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery) pipelines
Junit testing, Test Driven Development and Spring Integration testing
Nice to have experience with observability technologies - Prometheus/Grafana/ELK
Good knowledge of issue and code versioning tools (Azure DevOps)
Good knowledge of DBMS and SQL (Oracle, PL/SQL)
Good knowledge of IT Technologies
Good English and Italian level (written and spoken)
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office
Passion for technology
Excellence in execution
Effective communication
Able to work under pressure
Available for on-call service upon request
Working conditions:Full Time
Location:Milan (hybrid)
